# SecureClaw AI — secureclawai.com

**SecureClaw AI** is an AI security copilot for companies without a dedicated security team: 24/7 monitoring of endpoints, email, identity and cloud; plain-language threat explanation; and safe, approval-mode automated remediation.

## What it does
- **24/7 AI monitoring** — endpoints, email, identity, cloud, correlated in real time.
- **Plain-language alerts** — "what happened, what's the risk, what we did" instead of SIEM dumps.
- **Safe auto-remediation** — block / isolate / revoke / reset, suggest mode by default, per-action auto-fix whitelist, full undo log.
- **Phishing & email defense** — AI inbox analysis, click-to-quarantine, spoofing & impersonation detection.
- **Compliance auto-evidence** — NIS2, ISO 27001, GDPR: access reviews, incident log, patch state, export on demand.
- **Human escalation in one tap** — 2-minute handoff with a named human analyst when the AI isn't sure.

## Onboarding (3 steps)
1. Connect Google Workspace / M365, MDM or light endpoint sensor, one cloud account — read-only first.
2. Get a plain-language risk map within 24 h (the free 30-minute risk scan).
3. Choose remediation mode (suggest / approve / auto-for-low-risk) and start; alerts via email, Slack or WhatsApp.

| Plan | Price | Includes |

| Enterprise | Custom | Unlimited, auto policies + SIEM export, dedicated EU infra, SOC 2 + DPA, named analyst |
